description: Bug-backlog record — one file per bug under state/bug-backlog/<date>-<slug>.yaml. additionalProperties-posture: open — unknown fields in bug-backlog records are tolerated (not rejected). This preserves forward-compatibility as new optional fields are added without invalidating existing records. Decision: keep open; tighten only if strict-mode corpus conformance enforcement is required at a future governance stage.
_additionalProperties_note: Permissive by design — additionalProperties is not set to false here. Unknown fields in bug-backlog records are tolerated (not rejected), preserving forward-compatibility as new optional fields are added without invalidating existing records. Decision: keep open; tighten only if strict-mode corpus conformance enforcement is required at a future governance stage.

created.description: Date this bug record was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the bug.

surface.description: The surface/subsystem where the bug manifests.

from_repo.description: Originating repo, when the bug was reported cross-repo.

closed_at.description: Date this bug record was closed (YYYY-MM-DD).

closed_by.description: Identifier of the session/agent/person that closed this bug.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the bug report (log excerpt, reference, etc.).

environment.description: Environment in which the bug was observed.

why_blocked.description: Explanation of why this bug is currently blocked, when status=deferred.

initiative.description: FK to state/initiatives/<id>.yaml; nullable — absent equiv null. Spec backlink: pln-initiative-govern-sweep-priori-6cf808 § C0

system.description: Nested provenance/system metadata sub-object. All sub-fields are optional (no nested required array).

created_by_session.description: Session identifier that created this bug record.

created_by_agent.description: Agent identifier that created this bug record.

linked_sessions.description: Session identifiers linked to this bug's history.

linked_commits.description: Commit SHAs linked to this bug's history.

provenance_completeness.description: Whether the provenance metadata for this record is known-complete or unknown.
